ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the high risk of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much has the state spent on Medicaid programs at high risk for fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and abuse of taxpayer dollars. By analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and trends that may indicate fraudulent activity.

ideas.title: Federal Officer Misconduct in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of misconduct by federal officers in Minnesota, including the detention of ChongLy Scott Thao.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding Thao's detention?
Have there been other allegations of misconduct by federal officers in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a significant issue that affects the public's trust in law enforcement. By investigating these allegations, we can determine whether there is a pattern of misconduct and what steps are being taken to address it.
